Aisha Patel: Quick sync
Proposal idea: unify late-arrival handling by keeping a thin canonical event stream + an occasional correction stream. Keep consumers reading one reconciled output.
Marco Ruiz: Short: how do we track provenance for audits?
Aisha Patel: Each canonical event carries minimal provenance (producer, trace_id, nonce). Corrections reference canonical_event_id and include a human-friendly reason. Reconciler emits a signed 'window-proof' with pointers to the canonical and correction records.
Tess Nguyen: What about idempotency if producers retry?
Aisha Patel: Producer nonce + tenant dedupe table at ingest. Retries with same nonce are deduped. Corrective deltas have delta_id so reconciler applies at-most-once.
Marco Ruiz: Migration plan?
Aisha Patel: 1) dual-write (current path + canonical stream), 2) run reconciler shadow and compare, 3) flip billing to reconciled output, 4) retire old handshake.
ingest-bot: ingest pipeline wrote canonical-event e_20260318_01 for tenant t_47
Tess Nguyen: Ops note: add reconciliation-lag alert and a debug endpoint to fetch proof bundles for a window.
Aisha Patel: I'll draft RFC + migration checklist and tag infra/product. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
